commitResults.messageTitle: Configure agent guidance for the student workflow
Level-0: Rename chatbot and add greeting flow
Level-1: Echo commands until the user exits
Level-2: Store tasks and list them on request
Level-3: Allow completed tasks to be unmarked

commitResults.messageBody: Include the course-provided project skill so Level-3 structural refactors can be inspected as a self-contained HTML diff.

commitResults.messageTitle: Level-3: Represent tasks with a dedicated class
commitResults.messageBody: Move description and completion state into Task so marking and listing behavior stay together, satisfying A-Classes and preparing for typed task subclasses.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add repeatable console UI testing workflow
commitResults.messageBody: Document the post-change testing rule, add a fail-fast Java 25 runner, and seed the plan with typed-task scenarios for Level 4.

commitResults.messageTitle: Level-4: Add typed tasks with inheritance
commitResults.messageBody: Model todos, deadlines, and events as Task subclasses, preserve date and time text, and reject untyped fallback tasks.
Validate every command before changing task state, report malformed input through a custom checked exception, and extend the Java 25 UI plan with recovery cases.

commitResults.messageTitle: Level-6: Delete tasks from an ArrayList
commitResults.messageBody: Move task storage to ArrayList, add validated deletion with automatic renumbering, and cover valid and invalid delete flows in the Java 25 UI plan.

commitResults.messageTitle: A-Enums: Dispatch commands by command type
commitResults.messageBody: Represent the supported console commands with a dedicated enum and route parsing through an exhaustive command-type switch without changing user-visible behavior.
